description: This Dart source file defines the AttendanceRemoteSource class, which acts as a client for remote attendance and authentication APIs, handling JWT storage in SharedPreferences, making HTTP requests to login, logout, mark attendance, fetch daily and weekly attendance data, and subscribe to attendance events via server-sent events (SSE).

classes.name: AttendanceRemoteSource
classes.description: A class providing methods for authentication, attendance marking, data retrieval, and SSE subscription to attendance events, interacting with a backend server.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object based on the API base URL, given path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: _authHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the stored JWT token from SharedPreferences and constructs authorization headers.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sends login credentials to the backend, stores received JWT token and user info on success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears stored token and user information from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: hasToken
methods.description: Checks if there is a JWT token stored in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the stored user ID from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: markAttendance
methods.description: Marks attendance for a student on a given date and period, returning true if successful.

methods.name: getDaily
methods.description: Fetches daily attendance data for a specific date.

methods.name: getWeekly
methods.description: Fetches weekly attendance data starting from a specified week start date.

methods.name: subscribeAttendanceSse
methods.description: Subscribes to real-time attendance events via SSE, providing event type and data to callback.
